reason: I already have a brand I reorder when it runs out, and I don't have a reason to switch. Thirty foil sachets a month also feels like a lot of packaging waste for something I can take from a bottle.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, and I already have a magnesium routine with a brand I know.
would_change_my_mind: If my current brand ran out of stock or got worse, and this one came in recyclable or refillable packaging, I would try one box.
